method: Horizontal body specific acceleration from smoothed velocity derivative and attitude. Fit drag per mass using positive robust linear plus quadratic coefficients. Forward fits: linear 0.0070/0.0144 s^-1, quadratic 0.00447/0.00259 m^-1. Use 0.01/0.004 at the existing simulator mass 0.62 kg, isotropically because lateral excitation is weak.
limits: Partial calibration only. Keeps the existing abstract thrust/hover adapter, mass, inertia, vertical drag and motor lag. No claim of full original-drone system identification. These logs are development data, not an untouched test set.
